run_imagenet_validation: run the imagenet validation analysis script to evaluate a trained EMCom-AS-SSL model checkpoint
evaluate_game_model: evaluate a game model on a test dataset and report loss, soft accuracy, and game accuracy
save_interaction: save the full interaction data from model evaluation to a specified output folder
get_game_from_checkpoint: load a trained game model from a checkpoint path using configuration parameters
get_dataloader_for_evaluation: create a dataloader from a dataset directory with optional augmentations for evaluation
